The game started beeping when I find a pair. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Removed the match and win tones from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts:78), keeping the existing game transitions and feedback intact.

The locked install, type checks, build, and all 138 unit tests passed. The browser silence check also passed through a full game and restart.

The browser suite had 75 passing checks and one cancelled face-sheet check that timed out after 30 seconds. It timed out again when run alone.
